title: Highlights of Vietnam in 10 days
summary: Hanoi, one northern landscape, Hue, Hoi An, and out of Da Nang. Take Ha Long or Ninh Binh, and do not do both.

days.title: Day 1 — Old Quarter
days.body: Land in Hanoi and walk the Old Quarter north of Hoan Kiem Lake.

days.title: Day 2 — Lake and citadel
days.body: Walk Hoan Kiem Lake, see the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long, and eat bun cha.

days.title: Day 3 — Hoa Lo
days.body: Walk the cells at Hoa Lo, at 1 Hoa Lo, south of the lake.

days.title: Day 4 — Ha Long or Ninh Binh
days.body: Take the Ha Long boat for Ti Top, Sung Sot, and Luon, clocked at 5–6 hours, or go to Ninh Binh for Trang An, and do not do both.

days.title: Day 5 — Leave for Hue
days.body: Stay with the landscape you chose, then leave for Hue by train or by air. If you chose Ninh Binh, the Tam Coc sampan is about 2 hours on the water.

days.title: Day 6 — Hue Citadel
days.body: Visit the Hue Citadel and eat bun bo Hue.

days.title: Day 7 — Hue tombs
days.body: Visit the tombs of Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh.

days.title: Day 8 — Hoi An
days.body: Travel to Hoi An and walk the old town from the Japanese Covered Bridge. Tan Ky House is the old house.

days.title: Day 9 — Hoi An Market
days.body: Visit Hoi An Market and eat cao lầu.

days.title: Day 10 — Marble Mountains
days.body: Give Thuy Son at the Marble Mountains a morning, then fly from Da Nang.

seoDescription: Ten days from Hanoi to Da Nang: one of Ha Long or Ninh Binh, then Hue and Hoi An.
